_comment: Template only. Copy to livesync-data/livesync-settings.json, fill from a Setup URI,
chmod 600 it, and never commit it: it contains the CouchDB password and the vault
Preferred way to populate it (no copy-paste of secrets through a shell history):
Generate SETUP_URI on the Mac with the command
'Self-hosted LiveSync: Copy settings as a new Setup URI'
and choose 'Compatible (no time limit)' so it does not expire mid-migration.
Keep the URI and its passphrase out of the same channel.
_safety: syncOnlyRegEx is the allow-list that keeps this node from seeing anything but
the Zhihu subtree. Without it the node would also mirror private notes and,
worse, treat their absence on the NAS as local deletions.
Older builds spelled the device name key differently; verify with
if the database reports itself locked by a previous session.
trashInsteadDelete is NOT a safety feature any more (legacy key); the real
guards are the allow-list below plus the cron-style mirror loop.
syncOnlyRegEx: ^知乎收藏/|^assets/知乎视频/|^assets/知乎附件/
